simbad.query: select main_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, sp_type, otype_txt, plx_value, plx_err from basic where plx_value > 23 and ra is not null

nea.service: NASA Exoplanet Archive TAP, table pscomppars (Planetary Systems Composite Parameters; one row per confirmed planet)
nea.definition: a confirmed planet is a row of pscomppars, i.e. an object the archive lists as a confirmed planet on the access date
